notes: Original generic labels had no individual semantics; definitions are proposed v2 amendments, not recovered historical intent.
Reference fixtures conserve scalar value, but forged proposal prestates have no reachable-history proof.

Older width/timing source hashes retain their own historical full-source identity; original prefix/helpers are preserved.
